description: Reload a single process JSON file from the named plugin's knowledge base and update the live process registry entry. Performs full discovery rebuild after applying the change. Use plugin_name='ananta' for platform service interfaces.
embedding_description: Hot-reload exactly one process definition selected by its process_key after you edit that single verb's JSON, updating its one live registry entry without a restart. Targets a single named process and requires the process_key; for platform service interfaces pass plugin_name 'ananta'. Use right after changing one verb's wording, embedding text, or processor customizations.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation of the single-process refresh: refreshed_process_key (the process key that was reloaded), updated (whether the live registry entry changed), and errors (empty on a clean refresh)
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reloading a single process definition from a knowledge base JSON file
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: FileNotFoundError: process JSON file not found. ValueError: JSON validation failed (process_key mismatch). RuntimeError: orchestrator not available for registry update.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify the process_key and plugin_name are correct and the JSON file exists.
